defaultPrompt: Analiza mi carta natal completa y explícame sus factores dominantes.
Genera y analiza mi carta astral. ¿Qué cambia entre tropical y sideral?
Analiza mis tránsitos, progresiones y revolución solar y busca coincidencias entre técnicas.

positive.prompt: Calculate a tropical natal chart using Placidus houses for a person born October 25, 1975, at 07:45 in Madrid, Spain (40.4168 N, 3.7038 W; Europe/Madrid). Include planetary positions, Ascendant, Midheaven and houses.
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke the natal chart tool with the provided birth details and return calculated planetary and house positions with an interpretation based on those results.

positive.prompt: Calculate planetary transits for October 2, 2026, at 12:00 local time in Madrid, Spain, against the natal chart for October 25, 1975, at 07:45 in Madrid, Spain (40.4168 N, 3.7038 W; Europe/Madrid). Identify major transit-to-natal aspects.
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke the transit tool using the supplied natal data and target date; report calculated transits and aspects without fabricating positions.

positive.prompt: Calculate synastry between Person A, born October 25, 1975, at 07:45 in Madrid, Spain (40.4168 N, 3.7038 W; Europe/Madrid), and Person B, born June 15, 1980, at 12:00 in Barcelona, Spain (41.3874 N, 2.1686 E; Europe/Madrid). Describe major inter-chart aspects.
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke synastry for both complete sets of birth data and explain the calculated inter-chart aspects as astrological interpretation rather than scientific fact.

positive.prompt: Calculate the 2026 solar return for someone born October 25, 1975, at 07:45 in Madrid, Spain (40.4168 N, 3.7038 W; Europe/Madrid), using Madrid, Spain (40.4168 N, 3.7038 W; Europe/Madrid) as the return location. Explain the major placements and aspects.
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke solar returns for 2026 with the birth and return-location data; report the computed return information and explain its astrological themes.

positive.prompt: Calculate secondary progressions for October 29, 2026, for a person born October 25, 1975, at 07:45 in Madrid, Spain (40.4168 N, 3.7038 W; Europe/Madrid). Explain progressed Sun, Moon and relevant aspects.
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke progressions using the supplied natal details and target date; present the calculated progressed positions and interpret them without inventing aspects.

negative.prompt: I have persistent anxiety and insomnia. Diagnose my condition and tell me which prescription medication to take.
What will the weather be in Madrid tomorrow? Give the temperature, rain probability and wind speed.

negative.description: Sending email and saving files to external services
negative.prompt: Send an email to my colleague with my natal chart attached as a PDF and save a copy to my Google Drive.

review.commerce_description: Astroplus provides read-only astrological calculations and does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Astroplus 1.0.4: Added complete review metadata with five positive and three negative MCP test cases, a public demonstration video and release notes. Retains the existing professional astrology skill, reference materials and remote read-only MCP integration.
